description: Every authority in the library, with no query and no filter required. This is how you enumerate the library: what is in here, how big is it, summarise all of it. Optionally narrow by project ("none" for the unfiled ones), court, or tag, and sort by title, recency, year, or quote count. Pages through offset, and every row carries a one-line summary drawn from the user's own notes.

court.description: Keep only authorities whose court contains this text, case-insensitive.

offset.description: Skip this many rows; use the nextOffset from the previous call.

project.description: Project id or uid, or "none" for authorities filed under no project. Omit for all of them.

sort.description: title (default), recent (when it was saved), year (of decision), or quotes (how much language is saved from it).

tag.description: Keep only authorities carrying this exact tag, ignoring case. library_overview lists the tags.

name: list_cases
title: List authorities
